name: Seattle Metals, Inc & Waterjet
old_description: Seeking to deliver on our promise to be our customer’s partner, we focus our efforts not just on a project’s success, but on our customer’s success. With that aim, we develop plans that optimize our in-house capabilities and long term partnerships, while providing a one stop solution for your project needs.
about:
Seattle Metals, Inc & Waterjet was founded in 2013 in Everett, Washington, when two individuals pooled resources to purchase equipment that enabled same-day custom sheet metal bending. The company has since grown into a focused operation with a tight-knit team that emphasizes growth alongside its customers.

The shop specializes in custom sheet metal fabrication, producing items such as coping, siding, roofing panels, door pans, and other formed metal components. Its in-house capabilities include bending and waterjet cutting, allowing it to handle projects from small one-off pieces to larger production runs.

The company serves a broad range of customers needing custom metalwork, particularly in construction and architectural applications where coping, siding, and roofing components are used. Its partnership model targets repeat business, aiming to build long-term relationships with clients who value a collaborative approach.

Seattle Metals differentiates itself through unparalleled lead times at competitive pricing, a partnership philosophy that treats customer success as its own, and a value system centered on humility, excellence, and integrity. The founders started the business to provide a reliable, same-day bending solution that they themselves needed, and they continue to operate with a focus on exceeding expectations through continual improvement.
